phases.name: Choose a formation: formation data, then state and focus plan, then tactics screen

steps.name: Domain precursor: formation data in src/domain/formation.ts (about 2h, no dependencies; not shipped alone)
criteria: FORMATIONS is 4-4-2, 4-3-3, 4-2-3-1 in that order and DEFAULT_FORMATION is 4-4-2; isFormationId is a type guard that accepts exactly those three names and rejects 3-5-2, the empty string, names with surrounding whitespace and Object.prototype keys such as constructor and __proto__

lineUp(f) returns exactly 11 position codes: one GK first, then DF, MF, FW in non-decreasing order, with counts 1/4/4/2 for 4-4-2, 1/4/3/3 for 4-3-3 and 1/4/5/1 for 4-2-3-1; it equals the expansion of formationLines(f), whose 4-2-3-1 has two MF lines (2 then 3)
The formation data is deeply frozen (the list, every formation's lines array and every line), reading it twice gives equal answers, and it uses no ambient randomness or wall-clock time and no seed
ci:lint, ci:typecheck and ci:test are green; formation.test.ts is moved into tests/acceptance/S-004/ (git mv, .pending dropped) in the same commit as the code
steps.scenario_name: Given the three formations Sam can choose from, then they are 4-4-2, 4-3-3 and 4-2-3-1, in that order, and a new game starts at 4-4-2 (also every other scenario in formation.test.ts)

steps.name: State: formation field, initialState, ViewTactics, ChooseFormation, Back from tactics and focusPlan in src/app/state.ts (about 4h, depends on 01-01; not shipped alone)
criteria: GameState holds a required formation, always a known FormationId; initialState(league) starts on the title screen at 4-4-2 and NewGame resets the formation to DEFAULT_FORMATION; main.ts uses initialState instead of its state literal
ViewTactics from a known club's home opens that club's tactics screen with the formation unchanged; it is a no-op from every other screen and for an unknown club

ChooseFormation on the tactics screen of a known club with a known formation changes only the formation and keeps the screen; choosing the formation already held returns the very same state object; it is a no-op off the tactics screen, for an unknown club and for any unknown text

Back from the tactics screen returns to the same club's home with the formation kept (also after Squad, a player, Back, Back, Tactics); Back with an unknown club is a no-op; no input state is ever mutated

focusPlan(previous, next, focusId) is pure: it focuses the named element exactly when the screen is unchanged and the id is non-empty, else the heading (first render, any other screen change including a different club or player)

update stays split into per-action helpers under the oxlint complexity cap of 15; tests/acceptance/S-001/navigation.test.ts, S-002/navigation.test.ts and S-003/player-navigation.test.ts gain formation: DEFAULT_FORMATION in their GameState fixtures with assertions unchanged

tactics-navigation.test.ts and focus-plan.test.ts are moved into tests/acceptance/S-004/ (git mv, .pending dropped) in the same commit as the code; ci:lint, ci:typecheck and ci:test are green and tests/acceptance/S-004/existing-navigation-unchanged.test.ts stays green
steps.scenario_name: Given the tactics screen, when Sam taps 4-3-3, then only the formation changes and the screen stays Tactics (also every other scenario in tactics-navigation.test.ts and focus-plan.test.ts: Given the screen stays the same, then the element is focused exactly when the screen is the same and the id is non-empty, otherwise the heading)

steps.name: Tactics screen: tactics.ts renderer, Tactics button on the club home, main.ts wiring and focus, CSS, e2e (about 5h, depends on 01-02)
criteria: The club home has a button named Tactics after Squad, stacked, full width and 44px or taller; its h1 is still the club name; from the club home Sam reaches a chosen formation in 2 taps and the club home again in 1 (Back)

The tactics screen has exactly one h1 Tactics, focused on arrival; a radio group named Formation holds native radios 4-4-2, 4-3-3, 4-2-3-1 in order with only 4-4-2 checked for a new game; each visible label is 44px or taller and tapping it checks its radio; a list named Line-up holds 11 items, each exactly one position code, in order for all three formations and the same at ?seed=31 and ?seed=abc

Choosing a formation (tap or arrow key) checks only that radio, updates Line-up at once, keeps the single heading Tactics and leaves focus on the tapped or arrowed radio; tapping the checked formation changes nothing
The choice is kept after Back, Squad, a player and Back again, and is lost only on a fresh page where New game starts at 4-4-2; Back is 44px or taller

main.ts dispatches with (action, focusId?) and executes focusPlan; no file under src/ui calls .focus(); generated text enters the DOM only through el()/textContent; the Line-up and Formation labels are non-heading elements and the radios are never display:none, visibility:hidden or hidden
No horizontal scroll at 390px on the club home and the tactics screen, and no console errors; the S-001..S-003 e2e specs and tests/protected/S-001..S-004 pass

S-004-tactics.spec.ts is moved into tests/e2e/ (git mv, .pending dropped) in the same commit as the code; ci:lint, ci:typecheck, ci:test, ci:build and ci:e2e are green; zero .pending files remain under docs/feature/S-004/distill/pending/
steps.scenario_name: @walking_skeleton @kpi Sam taps Tactics, taps 4-3-3 (2 taps), sees it checked with its line-up, taps Back (1 tap) to the club home (also every other scenario in S-004-tactics.spec.ts, E2-E12)
